title: Obata theorem of $σ_k$-flat and constant associated $k$th boundary curvature equation
summary: On the upper hemisphere, we use the Obata-Escobar argument to establish an Obata theorem for $σ_k$-flat and positive constant boundary $\mathcal B_k$-curvature equation, which was initiated by Case-Wang [Adv. Math. 337 (2018), 83-106].
